parameters.html:
=

Interview Invitation: {{ $("Extract Position1").first().json.position }}

Dear {{ $("Generate Session").first().json.candidate_name }},

You have been invited to complete an AI-powered interview for the position of {{ $("Extract Position1").first().json.position }} with ScalePods. Please use the link below to begin.

Start Your Interview

Setup & Preparation

•Find a quiet, well-lit room
•Camera and microphone must be ready
•Stable internet connection required
•Use Chrome or Edge for best results
•Set aside ~15-20 minutes of uninterrupted time

Proctoring Notice

This interview is monitored to ensure integrity. By proceeding, you acknowledge:

•Video and audio are recorded throughout
•Your face must remain visible on camera
•Do not switch tabs or applications
•Copying or pasting text is not permitted
•No other people or devices should be present
•You must remain in fullscreen mode
•3 or more critical violations will terminate the interview

This link expires after 24 Hours.

Best regards,
ScalePods Team

ScalePods - AI-Powered Interview Platform

parameters.jsCode:
const jdText = $('Fetch Position1').first().json.raw_text || '';
const resumeText = $('Fetch Resume Session').first().json.raw_text || '';
const truncate = (t, max) => !t ? '' : t.length > max ? t.slice(0, max) + '...[truncated]' : t;

const prompt = `You are a senior technical recruiter designing a realistic live screening interview plan for a candidate.

Your task: analyze the Job Description and Resume, then produce a structured 10-question interview blueprint.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 1 — EXTRACT TOOLS & IDENTIFY GAPS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Extract 6-10 specifically named tools, languages, or frameworks required by the JD.

- importance: "must_have" if required/essential in JD, "nice_to_have" if preferred/bonus
- mentioned_in_resume: true ONLY if the exact tool name appears in the resume
- resume_context: the exact phrase from the resume where it appears, or null

Only flag GENUINE alignment gaps (domain mismatch, seniority mismatch, stack mismatch). DO NOT invent gaps for well-matched candidates — if the candidate fits well, flagged gaps should be zero or one.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 2 — DESIGN QUESTION PLAN (EXACTLY 10)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TARGET COMPOSITION:
- technical_jd (4-7): JD must_have tools first, nice_to_have after.
  - verification_mode: "verify_claim" if tool appears in resume (candidate claims experience), "baseline_check" if not (testing baseline awareness only)
- technical_resume (0-1): A tool the candidate claims on resume that is NOT in the JD — verify actual depth. Skip if no such tool exists.
- gap_probe (0-2): ONLY if real alignment gaps exist. Probe warmly and curiously, not accusatorially. Convert any unused gap slots to additional technical_jd.
- problem_solving (1): A real-world scenario or case-based question testing practical reasoning. No target_tool needed.
- cultural (2): Work style, collaboration, handling feedback, team dynamics.

DIFFICULTY GUIDE:
- "foundation": What the tool is, what problem it solves, key trade-offs. Use for early interview questions.
- "applied": Real implementation decisions, debugging approach, hands-on experience. Use for mid-interview questions.

COMPETENCY WEIGHTS: 1-5 where 5 = absolutely critical to job success, 1 = supplementary/nice to have.

expected_evidence: List 2-3 CONCRETE signals that would prove genuine hands-on experience. NOT generic ("has experience with React"). Be specific:
  ✅ GOOD: "Names specific React hooks they use and explain why", "Describes a real performance debugging scenario", "Explains trade-off between SSR and CSR"
  ❌ BAD: "Knows React", "Has frontend experience"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 3 — CANDIDATE SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- strengths: 3-4 specific resume signals that map well to JD requirements (be concrete, not generic)
- gaps: ONLY real gaps — things the JD requires that the resume shows zero evidence of. If none, return [].
- claims_to_validate: 2-3 specific resume claims that sound strong but need live verification (e.g. "Led a team of 8 engineers", "Built system handling 1M requests/day", "Reduced load time by 60%")

STRICT RULES:
- Competency names must be SPECIFIC tools ("React", "PostgreSQL") — never abstract ("frontend", "databases")
- Do NOT use the same tool in both technical_jd and technical_resume
- Total plan items must equal EXACTLY 10
- gap_ref must be null for non-gap plan items

Job Description:
"""
${truncate(jdText, 3000)}
"""

Candidate Resume:
"""
${truncate(resumeText, 3000)}
"""

Return ONLY valid JSON matching this exact schema:
{
  "competencies": [
    {
      "id": "react",
      "name": "React",
      "weight": 5,
      "description": "Core frontend framework required by JD",
      "expected_evidence": [
        "Names specific hooks they use and explains why",
        "Describes a real component architecture decision",
        "Can explain the trade-off between controlled and uncontrolled components"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "question_plan": [
    {
      "id": "plan-1",
      "category": "technical_jd",
      "competency_ids": ["react"],
      "target_tool": "React",
      "verification_mode": "verify_claim",
      "objective": "Verify depth of React experience claimed on resume",
      "question_type": "technical",
      "difficulty": "applied",
      "gap_ref": null
    }
  ],
  "candidate_summary": {
    "strengths": ["3 years of hands-on React at Acme Corp — matches core JD requirement"],
    "gaps": ["No evidence of Docker or containerisation despite JD listing it as must_have"],
    "claims_to_validate": ["Led a team of 5 engineers on the checkout redesign"]
  },
  "constraints": {"max_primary_questions": 10, "max_follow_ups_per_question": 1}
}`;

return [{ json: { prompt } }];
